about: Meaningful content for the Nordic Books dataset in the Variants 2.0 test studio (project ppsg7ml5, dataset variants-2-0). Base content plus per-variant overrides; a variant only carries the fields that differ so field marks show real changes. Source for the seed and the preview storefront. Written 2026-10-20.
